summary: SDK 54 → 57 regression testing. Backend fully passes (39/39 pytest). Frontend boots on SDK 57 (expo 57.0.19, RN 0.86.3, React 19.2.3), all 5 tabs (Ordini, Menu, Piatti, Clienti, Report) render and are navigable, order modal opens with correct item row (3 status icons + Modifica/Duplica/Cestino icon buttons), Home + Report show 'Aggiornato ora' freshness pill. However, a NEW frontend regression appeared: React Native Web 0.86 now strictly rejects stray text nodes inside <View>, producing a flood of console errors 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' plus a visible red error toast at the bottom-left of several tabs (Menu, Piatti, Clienti, Report). App remains functional but the error toast is user-visible.

ui_bugs.component: Global (React Native Web strict text-node check)
ui_bugs.issue: After upgrade to RN 0.86, hundreds of 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' errors are emitted, causing a persistent red error toast (id='error-toast') to render at the bottom-left of Menu/Piatti/Clienti/Report screens. Home/Ordini tab does not display the toast but console still floods with the same errors. Likely caused by stray whitespace or empty string children (e.g. `{condition && ' '}`, template literals producing '', or comments inserting whitespace) inside <View> components across the app.

action_items: Locate and remove stray whitespace/text nodes inside <View> components. Common culprits: JSX like `{value && ' '}`, `{cond ? 'x' : ''}`, or newlines between <View> and children rendered as strings. Grep for `&& ' '`, `? '' :`, and inspect components rendered on Menu/Piatti/Clienti/Report tabs first (the error toast is not shown on Ordini). Wrapping such content in <Text> or using nullish return will fix it.
Optional: bump expo to ~54.0.37 -> already resolved via node_modules to 57.0.19; expo-doctor should be re-run. Warnings in expo.err.log referencing expo@54.0.35 are stale from before the upgrade.

rca of the issue: React Native Web bundled with RN 0.86 (SDK 57) now throws when a raw text/whitespace string is a direct child of <View>. In SDK 54 (RN 0.81) this was silently ignored. Any JSX pattern like `<View>{someBool && ' '}</View>`, `<View>{arr.join(' ')}</View>` outside <Text>, or accidentally rendered empty strings will trigger the runtime error and the app's global error-toast handler. Mitigation: audit tab screens (menu.tsx, dishes/piatti.tsx, customers/clienti.tsx, reports.tsx) for such patterns; wrap in <Text> or replace with null.
